name: Google Maps and Places location search
manualSteps: Enable Maps JavaScript API and Places API (New) in one billing-enabled Google Cloud project.
Restrict the browser API key to exact application referrers and only the enabled Maps APIs.
Replace DEMO_MAP_ID before production and persist place ID, longitude, and latitude after user confirmation.
